title: Product Recall
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dunder Mifflin faces a crisis when an obscene watermark is discovered on their paper products, leading to a company-wide recall and public backlash. Michael attempts to manage the fallout through press conferences and apology videos, while employees take on various roles to address customer service and internal conflicts. Tensions rise as Barbara, a dissatisfied client, demands Michael's resignation, Angela refuses to apologize and eventually quits, and Debbie Brown is terminated. Meanwhile, personal dynamics unfold with Jim impersonating Dwight, Andy navigating a complicated relationship with a high school student, and Creed revealing a long-held secret.

main_threads.thread: The company crisis caused by the obscene watermark on Dunder Mifflin's paper and the subsequent recall and public relations efforts.
